GC01 Rider v2.1a — overlay header-path build repair
Scope: fix the failing overlay installation. No gameplay or layout changes.

ROOT CAUSE
The firmware copy of rider_render.h included "rider_core.h" even though it resides in ui/ and the core header resides in extras/. The install step explicitly checked for the correct relative include and silently exited on the failed grep. The user's screenshot ends immediately before that check. The local reproduction below fails on that exact line.

LOCAL TEST ENVIRONMENT
GitHub is unreachable from this runtime (git ls-remote: could not resolve host).
The uploaded Rad Pro binary-release ZIP lacks platform.io source. The local install reproduction used the source tree preserved in the earlier handoff, with only the old -DGC01_ARCADE flag removed from disposable fixture copies. This is not a verified checkout of pinned Git commit a9d0f19. Full ARM build and GitHub execution were not performed. All original uploads are unchanged.
